g.text: Rastok — one outbound Call, real or simulated
evaluate scripted response or remain silent
publish committed deliveries; apply Retry state
The Call closure and Connector transaction are distinct records.
A closed Call waits if the transaction cannot reserve capacity.
A timeout is an execution decision, not a Driver response.
An outbound result is not a new INGRESS root.
Retry-held emissions are journaled, not delivered to the graph.
Every exchange stays with its selected Driver object.
Drivers never assign envelope identities or write records.
Recovery does not repeat an already opened external operation.
